annotation.title_clean: Part 101—Moored Balloons, Kites, Amateur Rockets, and Unmanned Free Balloons
annotation.title_en: Part 101—Moored Balloons, Kites, Amateur Rockets, and Unmanned Free Balloons
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Federal Aviation Administration (US Department of Transportation), 14 CFR Part 101
annotation.summary_en: US FAA regulation (14 CFR Part 101) governing moored balloons, kites, amateur rockets and unmanned free balloons. It sets operating limits, notice, lighting and marking, and equipment requirements, and waivers. It contains no AI content and is only tangentially related to autonomous aerial systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines which balloons, kites, and rockets fall under the part by size and weight thresholds.
Prohibits operations that create a hazard to persons or property.
Requires ATC notification before moored balloon, rocket, and free balloon operations.
Unmanned free balloons need two independent cut-down systems, radar reflectors, and lighting.
Deviations require a certificate of waiver issued by the FAA Administrator.
